user.title: Add a Symetrix DSP
user.description: Connect to the control port of a Symetrix Composer DSP (Prism, Radius, Edge).

data_description.host: IP address of the DSP's control port (not its Dante port).
data_description.create_defaults: Add the default zones and source list. You can change them later.

unassigned.title: Unassigned controls
unassigned.description:
These control numbers are not assigned on the DSP: {controls}.

Assign them in Composer (with Push enabled), or submit to continue anyway; the matching controls stay unknown until they are assigned.

data_description.host: IP address of the DSP's control port.

init.title: DSP settings
init.description: Control-number layout, value mappings and sources.

data_description.sources: One source per line as 'selector input index: name', starting at 0.

data_description.base_power: Control number of zone N = base + N.
data_description.base_source: Control number of zone N = base + N.
data_description.base_volume: Control number of zone N = base + N.
data_description.base_mute: Control number of zone N = base + N.

data_description.power_on_value: Raw value that means the zone is on (0 when power is an output mute).
data_description.power_off_value: Raw value that means the zone is off.

data_description.fader_min_db: dB at raw value 0 (the fader's minimum in Composer).
data_description.fader_max_db: dB at raw value 65535 (the fader's maximum in Composer).
data_description.volume_min_db: dB that Home Assistant shows as 0% volume.
data_description.volume_max_db: dB that Home Assistant shows as 100% volume. Volume is never set above this.
data_description.turn_on_cap_db: When turning a zone on, lower its volume to this first if it is louder. Leave blank to disable.

data_description.resync_interval: Full re-read of every control, also used as a heartbeat.
data_description.push_interval: Minimum time between pushed updates from the DSP (PUI).

error.invalid_sources: Each source must be on its own line as 'index: name', with unique indexes (0-99) and names.
error.on_equals_off: On and off values must differ.
error.invalid_fader_range: Fader minimum must be below the fader maximum.
error.invalid_volume_range: Volume levels must be within the fader range, with 0% below 100%.
error.invalid_turn_on_cap: The turn-on cap must be within the fader range and not above the 100% level.

user.title: Zone
user.description: A zone on {dsp}, shown as a media player.

data_description.zone: 1-100. Control numbers are the type base + this number.
data_description.controls: Untick a control to leave it out of the media player.
data_description.zone_sources: Sources this zone can select. None selected = all sources.
data_description.area_id: Room the zone's speakers are in. Applied to the zone's device when the zone is created and whenever you change it here; an area set on the device page is kept.

data_description.cn_power: Leave blank for power base + zone.
data_description.cn_source: Leave blank for source base + zone.
data_description.cn_volume: Leave blank for volume base + zone.
data_description.cn_mute: Leave blank for mute base + zone.
data_description.volume_min_db: Leave blank to use the DSP setting.
data_description.volume_max_db: Leave blank to use the DSP setting.
data_description.turn_on_cap_db: Leave blank to use the DSP setting.
